title: Michelle's Doubles Day
style: warm acoustic pop, female lead vocal sweet harmonies, soft acoustic guitar, brushed drums, light upright bass, gentle ukulele, sunny uplifting, 100 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle on the right, partner on the left
Talking soft, ready and deft
Serve is in, return is up
Michelle is ready, never giving up

[Verse 2]
Third shot soft, gentle little arc
Michelle moves up, eyes on the mark
Side by side, partner and friend
The rally is long, but the soft hands win in the end

[Chorus]
Michelle and her partner, sunny little day
Doubles team, gentle little play
Little bright ball, up and over the line
Michelle and her partner, doing just fine

[Verse 3]
She says yours, partner says mine
They laugh together, all is fine
Not a sound goes by without a smile
Michelle plays gentle for mile after mile

[Chorus]
Michelle and her partner, sunny little day
Doubles team, gentle little play
Little bright ball, up and over the line
Michelle and her partner, doing just fine

[Bridge]
Soft little game, soft little crew
Michelle and her partner, always true
Friends on the court, friends off the court
Gentle little game, gentle little sport

[Outro]
Michelle and her partner…
Gentle little doubles…
Sunny little day… forever…
